name: webmesh.js
description: Search, fetch, and browse the web from your AI agent.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --minify --splitting --outdir dist --entry-naming webmesh.js --chunk-naming chunks/[name]-[hash].[ext] --external wreq-js && mkdir -p dist/skills dist/bin && cp -R ../../skills/* dist/skills/ && cp -R ../../packages/core/bin/. dist/bin/ && cp ../../packages/core/webmesh-agent-browser-config.json dist/ && cp ../../README.md ../../LICENSE .
scripts.prepack: bun run --cwd ../.. build:binaries && bun run build
